> 依据 [Logseq 固定版本 README](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/README.md) 翻译；仓库许可为 AGPL-3.0。上游数据库版、移动端和同步服务的测试阶段说明对应此版本，使用前请核对最新状态。

Logseq

以隐私为先的开源知识管理与协作平台

首页 | 博客 | 文档 | 路线图


## 目录 * [🚀 数据库版本](#-database-version) * [🤔 为什么选择 Logseq？](#-why-logseq) * [👀 如何使用？](#-how-can-i-use-it) * [📚 了解更多](#-learn-more) * [🫶 支持 Logseq 开发](#-support-logseq-development) * [💡 功能请求](#-feature-requests) * [🔌 插件 API](#-plugin-api) * [🌟 为 Logseq 做贡献](#-contributing-to-logseq) * [🛠️ 设置开发环境](#setting-up-a-development-environment) * [✨ 灵感来源](#-inspiration) * [🙏 致谢](#-thank-you) ## 🚀 数据库版本 Logseq 的数据库版本（DB 版本）引入了 DB 图谱。[此页面](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md)概述了 DB 图谱的主要功能。如果你是现有用户，请[查看 DB 版本带来的变化](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version-changes.md)。DB 版本有自己的新移动应用（iOS 已有，Android 即将推出）！如需参加移动应用 alpha 测试，请[填写这份简短表格](https://forms.gle/nfefJv51jUuULbFB9)。DB 版本还有一种新的同步方式 RTC（实时协作）！你可以用它在多台设备之间同步图谱或与他人协作。如需参加 RTC alpha 测试，请[填写此表](https://forms.gle/YSyF4WfKPSDuwyjH6)。 DB 版本处于 beta 阶段，而新移动应用和 RTC 处于 alpha 阶段。这意味着**可能发生数据丢失**，因此建议使用[自动备份](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md#automated-backup)或[定期备份 SQLite 数据库](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md#graph-export)。建议创建专用的测试图谱，选择一个对你不重要的项目。 开始使用 DB 版本： * 试用最新网页版：访问 https://app.logseq.com/。 * 试用最新桌面版：访问 https://github.com/logseq/logseq/releases/tag/nightly，下载适用于操作系统的构建产物。 * 从源代码构建以试用最新版： * 使用 `test/db` 获取稳定发行版。错误较少、更新较慢，更新频率为数天或数周。 * 使用 `master` 获取开发中的最新更新。预计错误更多、变化更快，更新频率为数小时或数天。 * 报告错误请提交到 https://github.com/logseq/db-test/issues。 * 功能或增强请求请提交到 Discord 的 `#db-feedback` 频道。 * 讨论： * 一般话题：Discord 的 `#db-chat` 频道。 * 同步与 RTC：Discord 的 `#sync-test` 频道。 * 移动端：Discord 的 `#mobile-test` 频道。 ## 🤔 为什么选择 Logseq？ [Logseq](https://logseq.com) 是**知识管理**和**协作**平台，注重**隐私**、**持久性**与[**用户控制权**](https://www.gnu.org/philosophy/free-sw.en.html)。Logseq 提供一系列用于**知识管理**、**协作**、**PDF 批注**和**任务管理**的强大工具，支持包括 **Markdown** 和 **Org-mode** 在内的多种文件格式，并提供**多种功能**来整理和组织笔记。 除了核心功能，Logseq 还有不断壮大的**插件**与**主题**生态，支持多种工作流及**自定义**选项。**移动应用**也可使用桌面应用的大多数功能。无论你是学生、专业人士，还是重视清晰有序地管理想法和笔记的人，Logseq 都是希望提高效率和简化工作流程的人的一个优秀选择。 ![logseq-demo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25513724/221387376-4dc419c2-0d0a-460c-a920-2d211e78b456.gif) ## 👀 如何使用？ 开始使用 Logseq，只需以下简单步骤： 1. [下载](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/releases/latest)最新版本的 Logseq。 2. 在设备上安装并启动 Logseq。 3. 开始写作 ✍️ 完成！现在你可以使用 Logseq 简化工作流程、管理项目并跟进目标。玩得开心！🎉 **Linux 用户**：使用自动安装脚本以获得最佳体验。示例依次为下载安装脚本、安装指定版本，以及无需 root 的当前用户安装： ```bash # Download and run the installer curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash # Or install a specific version curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash -s -- 0.10.14 # For user-specific installation (no root required) curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash -s -- --user ``` ## 📚 了解更多 * 网站：[logseq.com](https://logseq.com) * 文档：[docs.logseq.com](https://docs.logseq.com) * 常见问题页面：[Logseq 文档：FAQ](https://docs.logseq.com/#/page/faq) * 博客：[blog.logseq.com](https://blog.logseq.com) * 最新动态请访问我们的[关于页面](https://blog.logseq.com/about)。 * 论坛：[discuss.logseq.com](https://discuss.logseq.com)——我们在此回答问题、讨论工作流程并分享技巧。 * 论坛常见问题板块：[Logseq 论坛：FAQ](https://discuss.logseq.com/c/faq/6) * [Awesome Logseq](https://github.com/logseq/awesome-logseq)——社区创建的精彩 Logseq 扩展和资源 <3 * Twitter：[@Logseq](https://twitter.com/logseq) * Discord：[https://discord.com/invite/KpN4eHY](https://discord.com/invite/KpN4eHY) * [中文 Discord](https://discord.gg/xYqcrXWymg) ## 🫶 支持 Logseq 开发 如果你觉得 Logseq 有用，并希望帮助项目持续发展，请考虑在 [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/logseq) 支持贡献者。你的支持能让贡献者知道他们的努力受到认可，并鼓励他们继续出色的工作。每一份贡献，无论大小，都能帮助我们持续改进 Logseq。 ## 💡 功能请求 我们重视你对改进 Logseq 和让它更实用的意见。如果你有任何想法或功能请求，请在 [Logseq 论坛的功能请求](https://discuss.logseq.com/new-topic?category=feature-requests)板块分享。 你的反馈帮助我们理解用户需求，并确定对你最重要的功能的优先级。感谢你花时间分享想法。 感谢支持，期待听到你的创意！ ## 🔌 插件 API Logseq 提供插件 API，让开发者创建自定义插件并扩展 Logseq 的功能。插件 API 文档位于 [plugins-doc.logseq.com](https://plugins-doc.logseq.com/)，其中包含开始插件开发所需的一切。 我们重视你对改进文档的反馈和建议，如有意见或问题请随时联系我们。你的意见帮助我们为用户和开发者提供更好的体验。 感谢使用 Logseq，期待看到你通过插件 API 创造的作品！ ## 🌟 为 Logseq 做贡献 开始为 Logseq 贡献之前，请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/CONTRIBUTING.md)。你可以[贡献代码](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-contributions)，也可以[通过其他方式贡献](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#-how-can-i-help)。我们欢迎所有贡献，无论大小，并感谢你花时间帮助改进 Logseq。期待你的贡献 🚀 ### 🛠️ 设置开发环境 如需为 Logseq Web 或桌面应用设置开发环境，macOS/Linux 用户请参阅 [Develop Logseq](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq.md) 指南，Windows 用户请参阅 [Develop Logseq on Windows](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq-on-windows.md) 指南。 除了这些指南，还可以在 [docs/](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/tree/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/) 文件夹中找到其他实用资源，如[翻译贡献指南](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/contributing-to-translations.md)、[Docker Web 应用指南](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/docker-web-app-guide.md)和[移动端开发指南](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq-on-mobile.md)。 ### 🧰 Logseq CLI（Node） Logseq CLI 文档维护在 `docs/cli/logseq-cli.md`。 ## ✨ 灵感来源 Logseq 的灵感来自若干独特的工具和项目，包括 [Roam Research](https://roamresearch.com/)、[Org Mode](https://orgmode.org/)、[TiddlyWiki](https://tiddlywiki.com/)、[Workflowy](https://workflowy.com/) 和 [Cuekeeper](https://github.com/talex5/cuekeeper)。 我们非常感谢这些项目的开发者和创作者，希望 Logseq 能继续在他们的创新想法上发展，并让更多人能够使用这些想法。 感谢所有给予我们灵感的人，期待看到 Logseq 社区用这一工具创造的作品！ 以下项目也使 Logseq 的实现成为可能： * [Clojure & ClojureScript](https://clojure.org/)——动态、函数式、通用编程语言。 * [DataScript](https://github.com/tonsky/datascript)——面向 Clojure、ClojureScript 和 JS 的不可变数据库和 Datalog 查询引擎。 * [OCaml](https://ocaml.org/) 与 [Angstrom](https://github.com/inhabitedtype/angstrom)——用于文档解析器 [mldoc](https://github.com/logseq/mldoc)。 * [isomorphic-git](https://isomorphic-git.org/)——适用于 NodeJS 和 Web 浏览器的纯 JavaScript Git 实现。 * [SCI](https://github.com/borkdude/sci)——小型 Clojure 解释器。 # 🙏 致谢 我们衷心感谢 [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/logseq) 的**赞助者**、**支持者**和**贡献者**。你们的支持和贡献让我们能够继续开发并改进 Logseq。感谢你们成为社区的一员，帮助我们尽可能做好 Logseq！ ## Logseq

A privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration

Home Page | Blog | Documentation | Roadmap


## Table of Contents * [🚀 Database Version](#-database-version) * [🤔 Why Logseq?](#-why-logseq) * [👀 How can I use it?](#-how-can-i-use-it) * [📚 Learn more](#-learn-more) * [🫶 Support Logseq Development](#-support-logseq-development) * [💡 Feature requests](#-feature-requests) * [🔌 Plugin API](#-plugin-api) * [🌟 Contributing to Logseq](#-contributing-to-logseq) * [🛠️ Setting Up a Development Environment](#️-setting-up-a-development-environment) * [✨ Inspiration](#-inspiration) * [🙏 Thank You](#-thank-you) ## 🚀 Database Version The Database version (DB version) of Logseq introduces DB graphs. [See this page](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md) to get an overview of the main features for DB graphs. If you are an existing user, [see changes with the DB version](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version-changes.md). The DB version has its own new mobile app (on iOS, with Android coming soon)! To participate in the mobile app alpha, [please complete this brief form](https://forms.gle/nfefJv51jUuULbFB9). The DB version also has a new sync approach, RTC (Real Time Collaboration)! You can use it to sync graphs between multiple devices or collaborate with others. To participate in the RTC alpha, [please fill out this form](https://forms.gle/YSyF4WfKPSDuwyjH6). The DB version is in beta status while the new mobile app and RTC is in alpha. This means that **data loss is possible** so we recommend [automated backups](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md#automated-backup) or [regular SQLite DB backups](https://github.com/logseq/docs/blob/master/db-version.md#graph-export). We recommend you create a dedicated test graph and choose one project that’s not crucial for you. To get started with the DB version: * To try the latest web version, go to https://app.logseq.com/. * To try the latest desktop version, go to https://github.com/logseq/logseq/releases/tag/nightly and download the artifact for your operating system. * To try the latest by building from the source code * Use `test/db` for stable releases. Fewer bugs and slower updates. Update frequency: days or weeks. * Use `master` for the latest updates as they are developed. Expect more bugs and faster changes. Update frequency: hours or days. * To report bugs, please file them at https://github.com/logseq/db-test/issues. * For feature or enhancement requests, please file them on Discord on the `#db-feedback` channel. * For discussions: * General ==> see the `#db-chat` channel in Discord. * Sync and RTC ==> see the `#sync-test` channel in Discord. * Mobile ==> see the `#mobile-test` channel in Discord. ## 🤔 Why Logseq? [Logseq](https://logseq.com) is a **knowledge management** and **collaboration** platform. It focuses on **privacy**, **longevity**, and [**user control**](https://www.gnu.org/philosophy/free-sw.en.html). Logseq offers a range of **powerful tools** for **knowledge management**, **collaboration**, **PDF annotation**, and **task management** with support for multiple file formats, including **Markdown** and **Org-mode**, and **various features** for organizing and structuring your notes. In addition to its core features, Logseq has a growing ecosystem of **plugins** and **themes** that enable a wide range of workflows and **customization** options. **Mobile apps** are also available, providing access to most of the features of the desktop application. Whether you're a student, a professional, or anyone who values a clear and organized approach to managing your ideas and notes, Logseq is an excellent choice for anyone looking to improve their productivity and streamline their workflow. ![logseq-demo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25513724/221387376-4dc419c2-0d0a-460c-a920-2d211e78b456.gif) ## 👀 How can I use it? To start using Logseq, follow these simple steps: 1. [Download](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/releases/latest) the latest version of Logseq 2. Install Logseq on your device and launch the application 3. Start writing ✍️ That's it! You can now enjoy the benefits of using Logseq to streamline your workflow, manage your projects, and stay on top of your goals. Have fun! 🎉 **Linux users**: Use the automated installer script for the best experience: ```bash # Download and run the installer curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash # Or install a specific version curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash -s -- 0.10.14 # For user-specific installation (no root required) curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logseq/logseq/master/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash -s -- --user ``` ## 📚 Learn more * Website: [logseq.com](https://logseq.com) * Documentation: [docs.logseq.com](https://docs.logseq.com) * FAQ page: [Logseq Docs: FAQ](https://docs.logseq.com/#/page/faq) * Blog: [blog.logseq.com](https://blog.logseq.com) * Please visit our [About page](https://blog.logseq.com/about) for the latest updates. * Forum: [discuss.logseq.com](https://discuss.logseq.com) - Where we answer questions, discuss workflows, and share tips * FAQ forum section: [Logseq Forum: FAQ](https://discuss.logseq.com/c/faq/6) * [Awesome Logseq](https://github.com/logseq/awesome-logseq) - Awesome Logseq extensions and resources created by the community <3 * Twitter: [@Logseq](https://twitter.com/logseq) * Discord: [https://discord.com/invite/KpN4eHY](https://discord.com/invite/KpN4eHY) * [中文 Discord](https://discord.gg/xYqcrXWymg) ## 🫶 Support Logseq Development If you find Logseq useful and want to help us keep the project growing, please consider supporting our contributors on [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/logseq). Your support shows our contributors that their efforts are appreciated and motivates them to continue their excellent work. Every contribution, no matter how small, helps us keep improving Logseq. ## 💡 Feature requests We value your input on improving Logseq and making it more useful for you. If you have any ideas or feature requests, please share them in the [Logseq Forum: Feature Requests](https://discuss.logseq.com/new-topic?category=feature-requests) section. Your feedback helps us understand our users' needs and prioritize the features that matter most to you. We appreciate your time and effort in sharing your thoughts with us. We appreciate your support, and we look forward to hearing your ideas! ## 🔌 Plugin API Logseq provides a plugin API that enables developers to create custom plugins and extend the functionality of Logseq. The plugin API documentation is available at [plugins-doc.logseq.com](https://plugins-doc.logseq.com/), where you can find everything needed to get started with plugin development. We value your feedback and suggestions on how to improve our documentation. Please do not hesitate to contact us with any comments or questions. Your input helps us to provide a better experience for our users and developers. Thank you for using Logseq, and we look forward to seeing what you create with our plugin API! ## 🌟 Contributing to Logseq To start contributing to Logseq, please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/CONTRIBUTING.md). There are ways to contribute [with code](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-contributions) and [without code](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#-how-can-i-help). We welcome all contributions, big or small, and we appreciate your time and effort in helping us improve Logseq. We look forward to your contributions 🚀 ### 🛠️ Setting Up a Development Environment If you want to set up a development environment for the Logseq web or desktop app, please refer to the [Develop Logseq](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq.md) guide for macOS/Linux users and the [Develop Logseq on Windows](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq-on-windows.md) guide for Windows users. In addition to these guides, you can also find other helpful resources in the [docs/](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/tree/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/) folder, such as the [Guide for Contributing to Translations](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/contributing-to-translations.md), the [Docker Web App Guide](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/docker-web-app-guide.md) and the [mobile development guide](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/blob/e7e9c97c7fcb9c95d1bea156124a12bb20eea053/docs/develop-logseq-on-mobile.md) ### 🧰 Logseq CLI (Node) Logseq CLI documentation is maintained in `docs/cli/logseq-cli.md`. ## ✨ Inspiration Logseq is inspired by several unique tools and projects, including [Roam Research](https://roamresearch.com/), [Org Mode](https://orgmode.org/), [TiddlyWiki](https://tiddlywiki.com/), [Workflowy](https://workflowy.com/), and [Cuekeeper](https://github.com/talex5/cuekeeper). We owe a huge debt of gratitude to the developers and creators of these projects, and we hope that Logseq can continue to build on their innovative ideas and make them accessible to a broader audience. Thank you to all those who inspire us, and we look forward to seeing what the Logseq community will create with this tool! Logseq is also made possible by the following projects: * [Clojure & ClojureScript](https://clojure.org/) - A dynamic, functional, general-purpose programming language * [DataScript](https://github.com/tonsky/datascript) - An immutable database and Datalog query-engine for Clojure, ClojureScript and JS * [OCaml](https://ocaml.org/) & [Angstrom](https://github.com/inhabitedtype/angstrom), for the document parser [mldoc](https://github.com/logseq/mldoc) * [isomorphic-git](https://isomorphic-git.org/) - A pure JavaScript implementation of Git for NodeJS and web browsers * [SCI](https://github.com/borkdude/sci) - A Small Clojure Interpreter # 🙏 Thank You We want to express our sincere gratitude to our [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/logseq) **sponsors**, **backers**, and **contributors**. Your support and contributions allow us to continue developing and improving Logseq. Thank you for being a part of our community and helping us make Logseq the best it can be! ## 💎 Sponsors
